key_numbers.label: Asylum seekers in Democratic Republic of the Congo, 2025

explainer.counted: Sudanese asylum seekers in the Democratic Republic of the Congo on 31 December 2025, as reported to UNHCR.
explainer.type: A stock: people present at the end of the year, not the number who arrived that year.
explainer.not_included: People already recognised as refugees, and people who never applied.
explainer.reliability: Reported to UNHCR, often by the host government. The data does not say, row by row, whether a figure is a government count, a registration count or an estimate. UNHCR adds a footnote to this figure.

key_numbers.label: First figure (2000)
key_numbers.sub: UNHCR shows 0 or no report before 2000

explainer.counted: The first year-end figure above 0 in UNHCR's series for this group (2000). Before 2000 UNHCR's data shows 0, which can mean 0 or not reported. The latest figure (2025) is also the highest on record.
explainer.type: A stock: people present at the end of the year, not the number who arrived that year.
explainer.not_included: People already recognised as refugees, and people who never applied.
explainer.reliability: Reported to UNHCR, often by the host government. The data does not say, row by row, whether a figure is a government count, a registration count or an estimate.

key_numbers.label: Share of all Sudanese asylum seekers

explainer.counted: Sudanese asylum seekers in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as a share of all Sudanese asylum seekers in every host country on 31 December 2025 ({n0} of {n1}).
explainer.type: A share: one year-end stock divided by another, both from the same source.
explainer.not_included: People displaced inside the country of origin, and people counted under other groups.
explainer.reliability: Reported to UNHCR, often by the host government. The data does not say, row by row, whether a figure is a government count, a registration count or an estimate.
